paragraphs.text: Sketch is a unique acorn colorless creature type that represents rough preliminary drawings.

Sketch debuted as a creature type in Unfinity as tokens created by D00-DL, Caricaturist . Currently, only one token has the Sketch subtype. Sketches have unique abilities based on the art created by the player within a 15-second time limit. Wings represent flying , a sword represents first strike , a shield represents vigilance , mean eyes represent menace , horns represent trample , claws represent deathtouch , fangs represent lifelink , and footwear represents haste .
